label: Restrict application tables to the NestJS API

precheck.description: Supabase Data API grants may need to be removed
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
  WHERE table_schema = 'public'
    AND table_name IN ('companies', 'inventory_items', 'location_stocks', 'locations', 'stock_movements', 'users')
    AND grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated')
    AND privilege_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')
) AS result

execute.description: Revoke direct Data API access to application data

postcheck.description: Verify direct Data API grants were removed
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
  WHERE table_schema = 'public'
    AND table_name IN ('companies', 'inventory_items', 'location_stocks', 'locations', 'stock_movements', 'users')
    AND grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated')
    AND privilege_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')
) AS result
